Name: Annihilation
Description: Annihilation is the Dark God of Amenth who possess anyone who wields The Golden Helm of Amenth. Annihilation along with the Shadow King, the Adversary, the First Fallen, le Bete Noir, and the Goblin Force are all implied to be different aspects of the same entity, an oppositional force to the Phoenix Force.
